sections.title: And concerning the writing of the Gospel.

verses.text: በእኛ ዘንድ የተፈጸመውንና የታመነውን የሥራውን ዜና በሥርዐት ሊጽፉ የጀመሩ ብዙዎች ናቸው።
ከእኛ አስቀድሞ በዐይን ያዩትና የቃሉ አገልጋዮች የነበሩ እንደ አስተላለፉልን፤
የከበርህ ቴዎፍሎስ ሆይ፥ ከመጀመሪያው ተከትዬ፥ ሁሉንም በየተራው እውነተኛውን እጽፍልህ ዘንድ መልካም ሁኖ ታየኝ።
የተማርኸውን የነገሩን እውነት ጠንቅቀህ ታውቅ ዘንድ።

sections.title: Concerning Zechariah and concerning Elizabeth.

verses.text: In the days of Herod, king of Judah, there was a certain priest named Zechariah, of the division of Abijah; and his wife was of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elizabeth.
Both were righteous before God, walking blamelessly in all the commandments and statutes of the Lord.
And they had no child, because Elizabeth was barren, and both were advanced in years.
While he was serving as priest before God when his division was on duty,
the time came for him to enter the temple of the Lord and burn incense.
And the whole multitude of the people were praying outside at the hour of incense.
And there appeared to him an angel of the Lord standing on the right side of the altar of incense.
And Zechariah was troubled when he saw him, and fear fell upon him.
But the angel said to him, "Do not be afraid, Zechariah, for your prayer has been heard, and your wife Elizabeth will bear you a son, and you shall call his name John.
And you will have joy and gladness, and many will rejoice at his birth."
እርሱ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ታላቅ ይሆናልና የወይን ጠጅና የሚያሰክርም መጠጥ ሁሉ አይጠጣም፤ ከእናቱ ማሕፀን ጀምሮም መንፈስ ቅዱስ ይመላበታል።
ከእስራኤልም ልጆች ብዙዎችን ወደ አምላካቸው ወደ እግዚአብሔር ይመልሳቸዋል።
እርሱም የአባቶችን ልብ ወደ ልጆች፥ የከሓድያንንም ዐሳብ ወደ ጻድቃን ዕውቀት ይመልስ ዘንድ፥ ሕዝብንም ለእግዚአብሔር የተዘጋጀ ያደርግ ዘንድ በኤልያስ መንፈስና ኀይል በፊቱ ይሄዳል።”
ዘካርያስም የእግዚአብሔርን መልአክ እንዲህ አለው፥ “ይህ እንደሚሆን በምን አውቃለሁ? እነሆ፥ እኔ አርጅችአለሁ፤ የሚስቴም ዘመንዋ አልፏል።”
መልአኩም መልሶ እንዲህ አለው፥ “እኔ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት የምቆመው ገብርኤል ነኝ፤ ይህንም እነግርህና አበሥርህ ዘንድ ወደ አንተ ተልኬአለሁ።
አሁንም በጊዜው የሚሆነውንና የሚፈጸመውን ነገሬን አላመንኽኝምና ይህ እስኪሆን ድረስ ዲዳ ትሆናለህ፤ መናገርም ይሳንሃል።”
ሕዝቡ ግን ዘካርያስን ይጠብቁት ነበር፤ በቤተ መቅደስ ውስጥ ዘግይቶ ነበርና እጅግ ተደነቁ።
ወደ እነርሱ ወደ ውጭ በወጣ ጊዜም እነርሱን ማነጋገር ተሳነው፤ በቤተ መቅደስም የተገለጠለት እንዳለ ዐወቁ፤ እንዲሁም ዲዳ ሆኖ በእጁ እያመለከታቸው ኖረ።
ከዚህም በኋላ የማገልገሉ ወራት በተፈጸመ ጊዜ ወደ ቤቱ ገባ።
ከእነዚያም ቀኖች በኋላ ሚስቱ ኤልሳቤጥ ፀነሰች፤ ፅንስዋንም ለአምስት ወር ሸሸገች፤ እንዲህ ስትል፦
"The Lord said, 'In this time of trouble, when I am far from man, may He do thus for me when I call upon Him.'"

sections.title: Holy Gabriel, as thou didst greet our mother.

verses.text: In the sixth month, the angel Gabriel was sent from God unto a city of Galilee, named Nazareth, to a virgin espoused to a man whose name was Joseph, of the house of David; and the virgin's name was Mary.
And the name of that virgin was Mary.
And the angel came in unto her, and said, “Hail, thou that art highly favored, the Lord is with thee: blessed art thou among women.”
And when she saw him, she was troubled at his saying, and cast in her mind what manner of salutation this should be.
And the angel said unto her, “Fear not, Mary: for thou hast found favor with God.”
And behold, thou shalt conceive in thy womb, and bring forth a son, and shalt call his name Jesus.
He shall be great, and shall be called the Son of the Highest: and the Lord God shall give unto him the throne of his father David.
And he shall reign over the house of Jacob for ever; and of his kingdom there shall be no end.”
Then said Mary unto the angel, “How shall this be, seeing I know not a man?”

And the angel answered and said unto her, “The Holy Ghost shall come upon thee, and the power of the Highest shall overshadow thee: therefore also that holy thing which shall be born of thee shall be called the Son of God.”
እነሆ፥ ከዘመዶችሽ ወገን የምትሆን ኤልሣቤጥም እርስዋ እንኳ በእርጅናዋ ወንድ ልጅን ፀንሳለች፤ መካን ትባል የነበረችው ከፀነሰች እነሆ፥ ይህ ስድስተኛ ወር ነው።
ለእግዚአብሔር የሚሳነው ነገር የለምና”።
ማርያምም መልአኩን፥ “እነሆኝ፥ የእግዚአብሔር ባሪያው አለሁ፤ እንደ ቃልህ ይሁንልኝ” አለችው፤ ከዚህ በኋላም መልአኩ ከእርስዋ ዘንድ ሄደ።

sections.title: And Mary went unto Elizabeth concerning her journey.

verses.text: And in those days, Mary arose and went with haste into the hill country, to a city of Judah.
And she entered the house of Zechariah and greeted Elizabeth.
And when Elizabeth heard the greeting of Mary, the babe leaped in her womb; and Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit.
And she exclaimed with a loud cry, “Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the fruit of your womb!
And why is this granted to me that the mother of my Lord should come to me?
For behold, when the sound of your greeting came to my ears, the babe in my womb leaped for joy.
And blessed is she who believed that there would be a fulfillment of what was spoken to her from the Lord.”
And Mary said, “My soul magnifies the Lord,
and my spirit rejoices in God my Savior;
for he has looked on the humble estate of his servant. For behold, from now on all generations will call me blessed.
Great works He hath done; His name is holy.
His mercy is for those who fear Him, from generation to generation.
He hath shown strength with His arm; He hath scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.
He hath put down the mighty from their thrones, and exalted those of low degree.
He hath filled the hungry with good things; and the rich He hath sent away empty.
He hath helped His servant Israel, in remembrance of His mercy.
As He spake to our fathers, to Abraham, and to his seed forever.
And Mary remained with her about three months, and returned to her own house.

sections.title: Concerning the birth of John.

verses.text: The time of Elizabeth's delivery came; and she bore a son.
Her neighbors and relatives heard that the Lord had shown great mercy to her, and they rejoiced with her.
And it came to pass on the eighth day, they came to circumcise the child; and they called him by the name of his father, Zacharias.
But his mother answered and said, "No, he shall be called John."
And they said to her, "There is no one among your relatives who is called by this name."
And they made signs to his father, what he would have him called.
And he asked for a writing tablet and wrote, saying, "His name is John." And they all marveled.
And immediately his mouth was opened, and his tongue loosed, and he spoke, praising God.
And fear came on all who dwelt around them; and all these sayings were discussed throughout all the hill country of Judea.
And all those who heard them kept them in their hearts, saying, "What then will this child be?" For the hand of the Lord was with him.
And the Spirit of the Lord came upon Zechariah, the son of his father; and he prophesied, saying:
"Let us be forgiven, for the God of Israel, the Lord, who has shown mercy to our fathers, may He be praised;
He has raised up for us a mighty horn of salvation from the house of His servant David;
As He spoke by the mouth of His holy prophets, which have been since the world began.
To deliver us from our enemies, and from the hand of all that hate us;
To perform the mercy promised to our fathers, and to remember His holy covenant;
The oath which He swore to our father Abraham,
That we being delivered out of the hand of our enemies might serve Him without fear,
In holiness and righteousness before Him, all the days of our life.
And thou, child, shalt be called the prophet of the Highest; for thou shalt go before the face of the Lord to prepare His ways."
ኀጢአታቸው ይሰረይላቸው ዘንድ መድኀኒታቸውን እንዲያውቁ ለአሕዛብ ትሰጣቸው ዘንድ።
ከአርያም በጐበኘን በአምላካችን በይቅርታውና በቸርነቱ።
በጨለማና በሞት ጥላ ለነበሩት ብርሃኑን ያሳያቸው ዘንድ፥ እግሮቻችንንም ወደ ሰላም ጎዳና ያቀና ዘንድ ወጣ።”
ሕፃኑም አደገ፤ በመንፈስ ቅዱስም ጸና፤ ለእስራኤልም እስከታየበት ቀን ድረስ በምድረ በዳ ኖረ።

sections.title: Concerning the numbering of the people.

verses.text: And it came to pass in those days, that there went out a decree from Caesar Augustus that all the world should be taxed.
This was the first taxation made when Quirinius was governor of Syria.
And all went to be taxed, every one into his own city.
And Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judea, unto the city of David, which is called Bethlehem; because he was of the house and lineage of David.
To be enrolled with Mary, his espoused wife, being great with child.

sections.title: Concerning the birth of our Lord.

verses.text: And there came the day when she was to give birth.
And she bore her firstborn son; she wrapped him in swaddling clothes and laid him in a manger, for there was no room for them in the inn.
And in that land there were shepherds; they were keeping watch over their flock by night.
And behold, an angel of the Lord stood by them, and the glory of the Lord shone around them, and they were greatly afraid.
And the angel said to them, “Do not be afraid, for behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy which will be to all people.
For there is born to you this day in the city of David a Savior, who is Christ the Lord.
And this will be the sign to you: You will find a Babe wrapped in swaddling clothes, lying in a manger.”
And suddenly there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly host praising God and saying:
“Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, goodwill toward men!”

So it was, when the angels had gone away from them into heaven, that the shepherds said to one another, “Let us now go to Bethlehem and see this thing that has come to pass, which the Lord has made known to us.”
And they hastened and went; and they found Mary and Joseph, and the babe lying in a manger.
And when they had seen it, they made known the saying which was told them concerning this child.
And all who heard it wondered at what the shepherds told them.
But Mary kept all these things and pondered them in her heart.
And the shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all they had heard and seen, as it had been told them.

sections.title: Concerning the child, to be dedicated and to enter into the house of the sanctuary.

verses.text: And it came to pass, when eight days were fulfilled, that they brought the child to be circumcised; and they called his name Jesus, as the angel had commanded them before he was conceived in the womb.
And when the days of their purification were accomplished, they brought him to Jerusalem to present him to the Lord, as it is written in the law of Moses.
"Every male that openeth the womb shall be called holy to the Lord," as it is written in the law of the Lord.
And according to the law of the Lord, it is commanded that two turtle doves or two young pigeons shall be offered for him.

sections.title: Concerning the righteous Simeon.

verses.text: በኢየሩሳሌምም ስሙ ስምዖን የሚባል አንድ ሰው ነበር፤ እርሱም ጻድቅና ደግ ሰው ነበር፤ እርሱም የእስራኤልን ደስታቸውን ያይ ዘንድ ተስፋ ያደርግ ነበር፤ መንፈስ ቅዱስም ያደረበት ነበር።
የእግዚአብሔርንም መሲሕ ሳያይ እንደማይሞት መንፈስ ቅዱስ ገልጦለት ነበር።
መንፈስም ወደ ቤተ መቅደስ ወሰደው፤ ዘመዶቹም በሕግ የተጻፈውን ያደርጉለት ዘንድ ሕፃኑን ጌታችን ኢየሱስን ወደ ቤተ መቅደስ በአገቡት ጊዜ፥
እርሱ ደግሞ ተቀብሎ በክንዱ ታቀፈው፤ እግዚአብሔርንም አመሰገነው።
እንዲህም አለ፤ “አቤቱ፥ እንደ አዘዝህ ዛሬ ባርያህን በሰላም ታሰናብተዋለህ።
ዐይኖች ትድግናህን አይተዋልና።
በወገንህ ሁሉ ፊት ያዘጋጀኸውን፥
ለአሕዛብ ብርሃንን፥ ለወገንህ ለእስራኤልም ክብርን ትገልጥ ዘንድ።”
ዮሴፍና እናቱ ግን በእርሱ ላይ ስለሚናገረው ያደንቁ ነበር።
ስምዖንም ባረካቸው፤ እናቱን ማርያምንም እንዲህ አላት፤ “እነሆ፥ ይህ ሕፃን ከእስራኤል መካከል ለብዙዎች ለመውደቃቸውና ለመነሣታቸው፥ ለሚቃወሙትም ምልክት ይሆን ዘንድ የተሠየመ ነው፤
"But you, in your heart, should be pure; to reveal the thoughts of many."

sections.title: Concerning the prophetess Hannah.

verses.text: And there was a prophetess named Hannah, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Asher; she was of a great age, and had lived with her husband seven years from her virginity.
And she was a widow of about fourscore and four years, which departed not from the temple, but served God with fastings and prayers night and day.
And she coming in that instant gave thanks likewise unto the Lord; and spake of him to all them that looked for redemption in Jerusalem.
And when they had performed all things according to the law of the Lord, they returned into Galilee, to their own city Nazareth.
And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, filled with wisdom: and the grace of God was upon him.

sections.title: Concerning his presence among the priests.

verses.text: And it was that every year, they went to Jerusalem for the feast of Passover.
And after twelve years, when the time was fulfilled, they went up to Jerusalem for the feast, as was their custom.
And when they had finished their work, they returned; but the child Jesus remained in Jerusalem, and Joseph and His mother did not know it.

And they were unaware that He had remained behind, and they sought Him among their relatives and acquaintances; and when they had traveled a day's journey, they began to look for Him among their own kin.
And when they did not find Him, they returned to Jerusalem, seeking Him.
And after three days, they found Him in the temple, sitting among the teachers, listening to them and asking them questions.
And all who heard Him were astonished at His understanding and answers.
And when they saw Him, they were amazed; and His mother said to Him, "Son, why have You treated us this way? Behold, Your father and I have been anxiously searching for You."
And He said to them, "Why were you looking for Me? Did you not know that I must be in My Father’s house?"
And they did not understand the statement which He had made to them.
And he went with them and came down to Nazareth; and he was subject unto them: but his mother kept all these sayings in her heart.
Our Lord Jesus was both in the sight of God and in the sight of man, in wisdom and in stature, and in favor.

sections.title: Concerning the testimony of John.

verses.text: ጢባርዮስ ቄሣር በነገሠ በዐሥራ አምስት ዓመት ጴንጤናዊው ጲላጦስ የይሁዳ ገዢ ሆኖ ሳለ፥ ሄሮድስም በገሊላ የአራተኛው ክፍል ገዢ ሳለ፥ ወንድሙ ፊልጶስም የኢጡርያስና የጥራኮኒዶስ አራተኛ ክፍል ገዢ፥ ሊሳንዮስም የሳብላኒስ አራተኛ ክፍል ገዢ ሆነው ሳሉ፥
ሐናና ቀያፋም ሊቃነ ካህናት በነበሩበት ወራት የእግዚአብሔር ቃል በምድረ በዳ ወደ ዘካርያስ ልጅ ወደ ዮሐንስ መጣ።
ስለ ኀጢአት ስርየት ለንስሓ የሚያበቃ ጥምቀትን እየሰበከ በዮርዳኖስ አውራጃ ዞረ።
በምድረ በዳ የሚጮኽ የአዋጅ ነጋሪ ድምፅ በነቢዩ በኢሳይያስ መጽሐፍ ቃል እንደ ተጻፈ፥ እንዲህ ሲል፥ “የእግዚአብሔርን መንገድ ጥረጉ፤ ጥርጊያውንም አስተካክሉ።
ጐድጓዳው ሁሉ ይምላ፤ ተራራውም፥ ኮረብታውም ሁሉ ዝቅ ይበል፤ ሰንከልካላውም የቀና ጥርጊያ ይሁን፤ ወጣ ገባው መንገድም ይስተካከል።
ሰውም ሁሉ የእግዚአብሔርን ትድግና ይይ።”
ዮሐንስም ሊያጠምቃቸው የመጡትን ሰዎች እንዲህ አላቸው፥ “እናንት የእፉኝት ልጆች፥ ከሚመጣው መቅሠፍት ታመልጡ ዘንድ ማን ነገራችሁ?
እንግዲህ ለንስሓ የሚያበቃችሁን ሥራ ሥሩ፤ አብርሃም አባታችን አለን በማለት የምታመልጡ አይምሰላችሁ፤ እግዚአብሔር ከእነዚህ ድንጋዮች ለአብርሃም ልጆችን ማስነሣት እንደሚችል እነግራችኋለሁ።
እነሆ፥ ምሳር በዛፎች ላይ ተቃጥቶአል፤ መልካም ፍሬ የማያፈራውንም ዛፍ ሁሉ ይቈርጡታል፤ ወደ እሳትም ይጥሉታል።”
ሕዝቡም፥ “እንግዲህ ምን እናድርግ?” ብለው ጠየቁት።
And He answered them, saying, "Let him who has two garments share with him who has none; and let him who has food do likewise."
And the tax collectors also came to be baptized, and they asked Him, saying, "Teacher, what shall we do?"
He answered them, saying, "Do not collect any more than what you have been ordered to."
And the soldiers also asked Him, saying, "And what shall we do?" He said to them, "Do not intimidate anyone or accuse falsely, and be content with your wages."
And the people were in expectation, and all were reasoning in their hearts about John, whether he was the Christ or not.
John answered them all, saying, "I indeed baptize you with water; but One mightier than I is coming, whose sandal strap I am not worthy to loose. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and fire."
His winnowing fan is in His hand, and He will thoroughly clean out His threshing floor and gather the wheat into His barn; but the chaff He will burn with unquenchable fire."
And he would admonish the people in many other things, and he preached the good news to them.

sections.title: Concerning the imprisonment of John.

verses.text: John also reproached Herod for taking his brother Philip's wife, Herodias, and for all the evil deeds that Herod had done.
Furthermore, above all these things, they seized John and cast him into the prison house.

sections.title: Our Lord concerning His suffering.

verses.text: And all the people having been baptized, our Lord Jesus also was baptized; and while He prayed, the heaven was opened.
And the Holy Spirit descended in bodily form like a dove upon Him, and a voice came from heaven, saying, "You are My beloved Son; in You I am well pleased." Luke 9:35.

sections.title: The Book of the Generations of Our Lord

verses.text: Our Lord Jesus was about thirty years of age; he was thought to be the son of Joseph.
The son of Eli, the son of Matthat, the son of Levi, the son of Melchi, the son of Jonan, the son of Joseph,
The son of Mattathias, the son of Amos, the son of Nahum, the son of Esli, the son of Naggai,
The son of Maath, the son of Mattathias, the son of Simeon, the son of Joseph, the son of Judah,
The son of Jonan, the son of Resh, the son of Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, the son of Neri,
The son of Melchi, the son of Hadi, the son of Josa, the son of Qosam, the son of Elmadan, the son of Er,
The son of Josech, the son of Eleazar, the son of Joram, the son of Matthat, the son of Levi,
The son of Simeon, the son of Judah, the son of Joseph, the son of Jonan, the son of Eliakim,
The son of Meliah, the son of Minan, the son of Matthat, the son of Nathan, the son of David,
The son of Esli, the son of Obed, the son of Boaz, the son of Salmon, the son of Nahshon,
The son of Amminadab, the son of Aram, the son of Orni, the son of Esrom, the son of Pharez; the son of Judah,

The son of Serug, the son of Reu, the son of Peleg, the son of Eber, the son of Shelah,

The son of Enos, the son of Seth, the son of Adam, the son of God.

sections.title: Concerning the temptation of the devil.

verses.text: Our Lord Jesus returned from the Jordan, having been baptized in the Holy Spirit; and the Spirit led Him into the wilderness.
For forty days and forty nights He was tempted by the devil, and during those days He ate nothing; and when they were ended, He was hungry.
And the devil said, “If you are the Son of God, command this stone to become bread.”
Our Lord Jesus answered, “It is written, ‘Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceeds from the mouth of God.’”
The devil then brought Him up to a high mountain and showed Him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.
And the devil said to Him, “All this authority I will give you, and their glory; for this has been delivered to me, and I give it to whomever I wish.”
Therefore, if you will worship before me, all will be yours.”
Our Lord Jesus answered, “Get behind Me, Satan! For it is written, ‘You shall worship the Lord your God, and Him only you shall serve.’”
Then he brought Him to Jerusalem, set Him on the pinnacle of the temple, and said to Him, “If you are the Son of God, throw Yourself down from here.”
For it is written: ‘He shall give His angels charge over you, to keep you in all your ways.’
"Let thy foot not stumble upon a stone; they shall bear thee up in their hands," it is written.
Our Lord Jesus also said, "Thou shalt not tempt thy Creator, the Lord God."
And the devil, after he had accomplished all these temptations, departed from him until the time.

sections.title: Concerning the beginning of His teaching.

verses.text: ጌታችን ኢየሱስም በመንፈስ ቅዱስ ኀይል ተመልሶ ወደ ገሊላ ሄደ፤ ዝናውም በሀገሩ ሁሉ ተሰማ።
በየምኵራባቸውም ሁሉ ያስተምራቸው ነበር፤ ትምህርቱንም ያደንቁ ነበር፤ ሁሉም ያመሰግኑት ነበር።

sections.title: Concerning His upbringing in Nazareth.

verses.text: ወደ አደገበት ወደ ናዝሬትም ሄደ፤ በሰንበት ቀንም እንዳስለመደ ወደ ምኵራብ ገባ፤ ሊያነብም ተነሣ።
የነቢዩን የኢሳይያስንም መጽሐፍ ሰጡት፤ መጽሐፉንም በገለጠ ጊዜ እንዲህ የሚል የተጻፈበትን ስፍራ አገኘ።
“የእግዚአብሔር መንፈስ በላዬ ነው፤ ስለዚህ ቀብቶ ለድሆች የምሥራችን እነግራቸው ዘንድ፥ ለተማረኩትም ነጻነትን እሰብክላቸው ዘንድ፥ ያዘኑትንም ደስ አሰኛቸው ዘንድ፥ ዕውሮችም ያዩ ዘንድ፥ የተገፉትንም አድናቸው ዘንድ፥ የታሰሩትንም እፈታቸው ዘንድ፥ የቈሰሉትንም አድናቸው ዘንድ፥
የተመረጠችውንም የእግዚአብሔርን ዓመት እሰብክ ዘንድ ላከኝ።”
መጽሐፉንም አጥፎ ለተላላኪው ሰጠውና ተቀመጠ፤ በምኲራብም የነበሩት ሁሉ ዐይናቸውን አትኲረው ተመለከቱት።
እርሱም፥ “የዚህ የመጽሐፍ ነገር ዛሬ በጆሮአችሁ ደረሰ፤ ተፈጸመም” ይላቸው ጀመር።
ሁሉም የንግግሩን መከናወን መሰከሩለት፤ የአንደበቱንም ቅልጥፍና እያደነቁ፥ “ይህ የዮሴፍ ልጅ አይደለምን?” ይሉ ነበር።
እርሱም፥ “በውኑ ባለ መድኀኒት ራስህን አድን፤ በቅፍርናሆም ያደረግኸውንና የሰማነውን ሁሉ በዚህም በሀገርህ ደግሞ አድርግ ብላችሁ ይህችን ምሳሌ ትመስሉብኛላችሁ” አላቸው።
እንዲህም አላቸው፥ “እውነት እላችኋለሁ፤ ነቢይ በሀገሩ አይከብርም።
እውነት እላችኋለሁ፤ በነቢዩ በኤልያስ ዘመን በምድር ሁሉ ብርቱ ረኃብ እስኪሆን ድረስ ሰማይ ሦስት ዓመት ከስድስት ወር በተዘጋበት ጊዜ ብዙ መበለቶች በእስራኤል ውስጥ ነበሩ።
Elijah did not send any of these to a woman who dwelt in Sidon, even though he was in need of sustenance.
In the days of the prophet Elisha, there were many lepers in Israel; however, none of them was cleansed, save Naaman the Syrian.
And all those who were in the wilderness heard this and were astonished.
Then they arose and went forth from the city; and they fled, saying that their city had been destroyed, and they went to the mountain where they had dwelt.
But he passed through the midst of them and went on his way.

sections.title: And they went to the grave.

verses.text: And He went to the city of Galilee and to Capernaum; and on the Sabbath, He taught them.
And He spoke with authority, for He was one who taught them with power.

sections.title: Concerning the one who has taken the yoke upon himself.

verses.text: በምኵራብም ርኩስ መንፈስ የያዘው አንድ ሰው ነበር፤ በታላቅ ቃልም ጮኾ፦
“የናዝሬቱ ኢየሱስ ሆይ፥ ከአንተ ጋር ምን አለን? ያለጊዜአችን ልታጠፋን መጣህን? የእግዚአብሔር ቅዱስ ሆይ፥ አንተ ማን እንደሆንህ ዐውቅሃለሁ” አለ።
ጌታችን ኢየሱስም፥ “ዝም በልና ከእርሱ ውጣ” ብሎ ገሠጸው፤ ጋኔኑም በምኵራቡ መካከል ጣለውና ከእርሱ ወጣ፤ ነገር ግን ምንም አልጐዳውም።
ሁሉም ደነገጡ፤ እርስ በርሳቸውም ተነጋገሩ፤ እንዲህም አሉ፥ “ይህ ነገር ምንድን ነው? ክፉዎችን አጋንንት በሥልጣንና በኀይል ያዝዛቸዋልና፥ እነርሱም ይወጣሉና።”
ዝናውም በዙሪያዉ ባሉ መንደሮች ሁሉ ወጣ፤ ተሰማም።

sections.title: Concerning the mother of Peter and concerning the other sick ones, to be healed.

verses.text: And He departed from there and entered into the house of Simon; and the mother-in-law of Simon was sick with a great fever, and they spoke to Him concerning her.
And they stood by her, and besought Him for her; and immediately He arose and ministered unto them.
And when the sun was setting, all they that had any sick with divers diseases brought them unto Him; and He laid His hands on every one of them, and healed them.
And many devils also came out, crying out, and saying, “Thou art Christ, the Son of God.” And He rebuked them, and suffered them not to speak, for they knew that He was Christ.
And when it was day, He departed and went into a desert place; and the people sought Him, and came unto Him, and stayed Him, that He should not depart from them.
And He said unto them, “I must preach the kingdom of God to other cities also; for therefore am I sent.”
And He was preaching in the synagogues of Galilee.

sections.title: Concerning the calling of Simon and the sons of Zebedee.

verses.text: And many were with him; they would listen to the word of God; but he was by the lake of Gennesaret.
And by the lake, two boats were standing; and from them, fishermen had gone out to wash their nets.
And he entered one of the boats, which was Simon's, and asked him to put out a little from the land; and he sat down and taught the people from the boat.
And when he had finished speaking, he said to Simon, “Put out into the deep and let down your nets for a catch.”
And Simon answered and said, “Master, we have toiled all night and caught nothing; nevertheless, at your word, I will let down the net.”
And when they had done this, they caught a great number of fish, and their net was breaking.
So they signaled to their partners in the other boat to come and help them; and they came and filled both the boats, so that they began to sink.
When Simon Peter saw it, he fell down at Jesus' knees, saying, “Depart from me, for I am a sinful man, O Lord!”
For he and all who were with him were astonished at the catch of fish which they had taken;
And so also were James and John, the sons of Zebedee, who were partners with Simon. And Jesus said to Simon, “Do not be afraid; from now on you will catch men.”
And they cast down their crowns to the ground and followed Him, forsaking all.

sections.title: For the sake of the afflicted, concerning the deliverer.

verses.text: And as he was in a certain city, there came a man who was full of leprosy; and when he saw our Lord Jesus, he fell on his face and besought Him, saying, "Lord, if Thou wilt, Thou canst make me clean."
And he stretched forth his hand and touched him, saying, "I will; be thou clean." And immediately the leprosy departed from him.
And he charged him to tell no man; but, "Go, and show thyself to the priest, and offer for thy cleansing, according as Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them," he commanded him.
And the fame of Him went out into every place; and many people came to hear His doctrine, and to be healed of their infirmities.
But He withdrew Himself into the wilderness and prayed.

sections.title: Concerning the act of writing.

verses.text: And after this, when He was teaching them on a certain day, there were Pharisees and teachers of the law who had come from the villages of Galilee and Judea, and from Jerusalem; and the power of the Lord was present for Him to heal.
Behold, men brought a man who was paralyzed, lying on a bed, and they sought to bring him in and lay him before Him.

And the man was brought in, being carried by four, and when they could not find a way to bring him in because of the crowd, they went up on the roof and let him down through the tiles into the midst before Jesus.
And when He saw their faith, He said to him, "Man, your sins are forgiven you."
And the scribes and the Pharisees began to reason, saying, "Who is this who speaks blasphemies? Who can forgive sins but God alone?"
But when Jesus perceived their thoughts, He answered and said to them, "Why are you reasoning in your hearts?
Which is easier, to say, 'Your sins are forgiven you,' or to say, 'Rise up and walk'?
But that you may know that the Son of Man has power on earth to forgive sins," He said to the paralyzed man, "I say to you, arise, take up your bed, and go to your house."
Immediately he rose up before them, took up what he had been lying on, and went to his own house, glorifying God.
And they were all amazed, and they glorified God and were filled with fear, saying, "We have seen strange things today."

sections.title: Concerning the calling of the Levite.

verses.text: And after this, there came a man named Levi, who was a tax collector, and he sat at the place of receiving taxes, and he said, "Follow me."
And they all rose up and followed him.
Levi made a great feast in his house; and there was a great multitude of publicans and sinners who sat down with him.
And the scribes and Pharisees murmured, saying, "Why do ye eat and drink with publicans and sinners?"
And our Lord Jesus answered and said unto them, "They that are whole need not a physician; but they that are sick."
"I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance."

sections.title: Concerning fasting.

verses.text: And they said, "Why do the disciples of John fast often and pray? And why do the Pharisees' disciples do likewise? But Your disciples, why do they eat and drink?"
Our Lord Jesus answered them, saying, "Can you make the friends of the bridegroom fast while the bridegroom is with them?
But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them; then they will fast in those days."

He spoke also a parable unto them, saying, "No man puts a piece of a new garment upon an old; if otherwise, then both the new maketh a rent, and the piece that was taken out of the new agreeth not with the old."
And no man puts new wine into old bottles; else the new wine will burst the bottles, and be spilled, and the bottles shall perish.
But new wine must be put into new bottles; and both are preserved."
And no man also having drunk old wine straightway desireth new; for he saith, The old is better."

sections.title: Concerning the Sabbath

verses.text: And after this, our Lord Jesus went into the fields on the Sabbath day; and His disciples began to pluck the ears of corn, and to eat them.
And the Pharisees said unto Him, "Why do ye do that which is not lawful on the Sabbath?"

But our Lord Jesus answered them, saying, "Have ye not read what David did when he was in need, and he, and they that were with him, how he entered into the house of God in the days of Abiathar the high priest, and did eat the shewbread, which is not lawful to eat but for the priests, and gave also to them which were with him?"
And when He entered into the house of God, and did eat the shewbread, which is not lawful to eat but for the priests alone, did ye not read that He gave also to them which were with Him?
"The Son of man is Lord also of the Sabbath," He said unto them.

sections.title: His hand concerning the one who is afflicted.

verses.text: And after this, on another Sabbath, He entered the synagogue and taught them; and there was a man whose right hand was withered.
And the scribes and the Pharisees watched Him closely, to see if He would heal on the Sabbath, that they might find an accusation against Him.
But He knew their thoughts, and said to the man with the withered hand, “Arise and stand in the midst.” And he arose and stood.
Then Jesus said to them, “I ask you, is it lawful on the Sabbath to do good or to do evil, to save life or to destroy it?”

But they kept silent. And when He had looked around at them with anger, being grieved by the hardness of their hearts, He said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” And he stretched it out, and his hand was restored as whole as the other.
And they were filled with rage, and discussed with one another what they might do to Jesus.

sections.title: Concerning the selection of the Apostles.

verses.text: In those days, our Lord Jesus went out to pray upon a mountain; He would pray all night long to God.
And when it was day, He called His disciples to Him; and from them He chose twelve, whom also He named apostles.
Now these are the names of the twelve: Simon, who is called Peter, and his brother Andrew; James and John; Philip and Bartholomew.
Matthew and Thomas; James the son of Alphaeus, and Simon who is called the Zealot.
Judas the brother of James, and Judas Iscariot, who also became a traitor.

And with them stood a great multitude of people from all Judea and Jerusalem, and from the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon, who came to hear Him and to be healed of their diseases; and those who were tormented with unclean spirits were also healed.
And the unclean spirits, when they saw Him, fell down before Him and cried out, saying, "You are the Son of God."
And the whole multitude sought to touch Him, for power went out from Him and healed them all.

sections.title: Concerning the teaching that was imparted upon the mountain.

verses.text: And He said unto His disciples, lifting up His eyes, “Blessed are ye, for yours is the kingdom of God.
Today you are blessed, for you shall be comforted; today you are blessed, for you shall laugh.
If men shall revile you for the Son of man, and shall separate you from their company, and shall reproach you, blessed are ye.
Rejoice in that day, and leap for joy; for great is your reward in heaven, for in like manner did their fathers unto the prophets.
But woe unto you that are rich, for ye have received your consolation.
Woe unto you that are full, for ye shall hunger; woe unto you that laugh now, for ye shall mourn and weep.
Woe unto you when all men shall speak well of you, for so did their fathers to the false prophets.
“But I say unto you who hear: Love your enemies, do good to them which hate you.
Bless them that curse you, and pray for them which despitefully use you.
And unto him that smiteth thee on the one cheek, offer also the other; and him that taketh away thy cloak, forbid not to take thy coat also.”
ለሚለምንህም ሁሉ ስጥ፤ ገንዘብህን የሚወስደውንም እንዲመልስ አትጠይቀው።
ሰዎች ሊያደርጉላችሁ እንደምትወዱትም እንዲሁ እናንተ አድርጉላቸው።
የሚወድዱአችሁን ብቻ ብትወዱማ እንግዲህ ዋጋችሁ ምንድን ነው? ይህንስ ኃጥኣንም ያደርጋሉ፤ የሚወድዳቸውንም ይወድዳሉ።
በጎ ለሚያደርጉላችሁ በጎ ብታደርጉ እንግዲህ ዋጋችሁ ምንድን ነው? እንዲህስ ኃጥኣንም ያደርጋሉ።
እንዲከፍላችሁ ተስፋ ለምታደርጉት ብታበድሩ እንግዲህ ዋጋችሁ ምንድን ነው? ኃጥኣንም በአበደሩት ልክ ይከፍሉአቸው ዘንድ ለኃጥኣን ያበድራሉና።
አሁንም ጠላቶቻችሁን ውደዱ፤ መልካምም አድርጉላቸው፤ እንዲመልሱላችሁ ተስፋ ሳታደርጉ አበድሩ፤ ዋጋችሁም ብዙ ይሆናል፤ የልዑልም ልጆች ትሆናላችሁ፤ እርሱ ለበጎዎችና ለክፉዎች ቸር ነውና።
ሰማያዊ አባታችሁ የሚራራ እንደ ሆነ እናንተም የምትራሩ ሁኑ።
አትፍረዱ፥ አይፈረድባችሁምም፤ አትበድሉ፥ አይበድሉአችሁምም፤ ይቅር በሉ፥ ይቅርም ይሉአችኋል።
ስጡ፥ ይሰጣችኋልም፤ የሞላና የበዛ፥ የተትረፈረፈም መልካም መስፈሪያ በዕቅፋችሁ ይሰጡአችኋል፤ በሰፈራችሁበትም መስፈሪያ ይሰፍሩላችኋል።”
ምሳሌም መሰለላቸውና እንዲህ አላቸው፥ “ዕውር ዕውርን ሊመራ ይችላልን? ሁለቱስ በጕድጓድ ውስጥ ይወድቁ የለምን?
ከመምህሩ የሚበልጥ ደቀ መዝሙር የለም፤ ለሁሉም መጠኑ እንደ መምህሩ ይሆናል።
በወንድምህ ዐይን ውስጥ ያለውን ጕድፍ ለምን ታያለህ? በዐይንህ ውስጥ ያለውን ምሰሶ አታይምን?
ወንድምህንም፦ ወንድሜ ሆይ፥ ታገሥ፤ በዐይንህ ያለውን ጕድፍ ላውጣልህ ልትለው እንደምን ትችላለህ? አንተ ግን በዐይንህ ውስጥ ያለውን ምሰሶ አታይም፤ አንተ ግብዝ፥ አስቀድሞ ከዐይንህ ምሰሶውን አውጣ፤ ከዚህ በኋላ በባልንጀራህ ዐይን ውስጥ ያለውን ጕድፍ ታወጣ ዘንድ አጥርተህ ታያለህ።
ክፉ ፍሬን የሚያፈራ መልካም ዛፍ የለም፤ መልካም ፍሬ የሚያፈራ ክፉ ዛፍም የለም።
ዛፍ ሁሉ ከፍሬው ይታወቃል፤ ከእሾህ በለስን አይለቅሙም፤ ከደንደርም ወይንን አይለቅሙም።
መልካም ሰው ከልቡ መልካም መዝገብ መልካምን ያወጣል፤ ክፉ ሰውም ከልቡ ክፉ መዝገብ ክፉ ነገርን ያወጣል፤ ከልብ የተረፈውን አፍ ይናገራልና።
“ለምን አቤቱ፥ አቤቱ፥ ትሉኛላችሁ? የምላችሁንም አታደርጉም።
ወደ እኔ የሚመጣና ቃሌን ሰምቶ የሚያደርገውም ሁሉ የሚመስለውን አሳያችኋለሁ።
መሠረቱን አጥልቆ ቈፍሮ የመሠረተና ቤቱን በዐለት ላይ የሠራ ሰውን ይመስላል፤ ብዙ ፈሳሾች በመጡ ጊዜ ጎርፎች ያን ቤት ገፉት፤ ሊያነዋውጡትም አልቻሉም፤ በዐለት ተሠርቶአልና።
ቃሌን ሰምቶ የማያደርገው ሰው ግን ቤቱን ያለ መሠረት በአፈር ላይ የሠራ ሰውን ይመስላል፤ ጎርፎች ገፉት፤ ወዲያውኑም ወደቀ፤ የዚያም ቤት አወዳደቁ ታላቅ ሆነ።”

sections.title: The voice of the watchman is like that of a lion.

verses.text: And after he had spoken the word to the people, he entered into the house.
There was a certain centurion; and his servant was sick and ready to die; and he was dear unto him.
When our Lord Jesus heard these things, he sent unto him the elders of the Jews, beseeching him that he would come and heal his servant.
And when they came to Jesus, they besought him earnestly, saying, “That he was worthy for whom he should do this:
For he loveth our nation, and hath built us a synagogue.”

Then Jesus went with them. And when he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying unto him, “Lord, trouble not thyself: for I am not worthy that thou shouldest enter under my roof:
Neither thought I myself worthy to come unto thee: but say in a word, and my servant shall be healed.
For I also am a man set under authority, having under me soldiers; and I say unto one, ‘Go,’ and he goeth; and to another, ‘Come,’ and he cometh; and to my servant, ‘Do this,’ and he doeth it.”
When Jesus heard these things, he marvelled at him, and turned him about, and said unto the people that followed him, “I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel.”
And they that were sent, returning to the house, found the servant whole that had been sick.

sections.title: Concerning the child of the deliverer.

verses.text: And it came to pass, as He was entering a certain city, that behold, there was a dead man carried out, the only son of his mother, and she was a widow; and much people of the city was with her.
And when He came nigh to the gate of the city, behold, there was a dead man carried out, the only son of his mother, and she was a widow; and much people of the city was with her.
And our Lord, in the time of the elders, had compassion on her, saying, "Weep not."
And He came and touched the bier; and they that bore him stood still. And He said, "Young man, I say unto thee, Arise."
And he that was dead sat up, and began to speak; and He delivered him to his mother.
And there came a fear on all: and they glorified God, saying, "That a great prophet is risen up among us; and that God hath visited His people."
And this rumor of him went forth throughout all Judaea, and throughout all the region round about.

sections.title: Concerning the messengers sent by John

verses.text: All these things were spoken by the disciple concerning John.
And John, having sent two of his disciples, asked, "Are You the Coming One, or do we look for another?" and he sent them to our Lord Jesus.
And the messengers came to Him, saying, "Are You the Coming One, or do we look for another?" Thus they spoke, sending John to You.
At that time, He healed many who were afflicted with various diseases and torments, and He cast out evil spirits; and to many who were blind, He gave sight.

Our Lord Jesus answered and said to them, "Go and tell John the things which you hear and see: The blind see, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have the gospel preached to them."
And blessed is he who is not offended because of Me."

sections.title: The Lord admonished John for his gratitude.

verses.text: After they had departed, John began to speak to the people concerning their coming, saying, "What did you go out to see in the wilderness? A reed shaken by the wind?
Or what did you go out to see? A man clothed in soft garments? Behold, those who are splendidly dressed and live in luxury are in kings' houses.
Or what did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I say to you, and more than a prophet.
For behold, I send My messenger before Your face, who will prepare Your way before You; this is what has been written concerning Him.
Truly, I say to you, among those born of women there has not risen one greater than John the Baptist; yet he who is least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he."
And all the people, when they heard Him, acknowledged the justice of God, having been baptized with the baptism of John.
But the Pharisees and lawyers rejected the will of God for themselves, not having been baptized by him.
"To what then shall I compare the men of this generation, and what are they like?
They are like children sitting in the marketplace and calling to one another, saying, 'We played the flute for you, and you did not dance; we mourned to you, and you did not weep.'
For John the Baptist came neither eating bread nor drinking wine, and you say, 'He has a demon.'”
And the son of man came, eating and drinking; and behold, ye say, Behold, a gluttonous man and a winebibber, a friend of publicans and sinners.
Wisdom hath justified herself by all her children.

sections.title: Concerning the Pharisee and the sinful woman.

verses.text: And one of the Pharisees asked Him to eat with him. And He went into the Pharisee's house, and sat down to meat.
Behold, a woman in the city, which was a sinner, when she knew that Jesus sat at meat in the Pharisee's house, brought an alabaster box of ointment.
And stood at His feet behind Him weeping, and began to wash His feet with tears, and did wipe them with the hairs of her head, and kissed His feet, and anointed them with the ointment.

Now when the Pharisee which had bidden Him saw it, he spake within himself, saying, “This man, if he were a prophet, would have known who and what manner of woman this is that toucheth him: for she is a sinner.”
And Jesus answering said unto him, “Simon, I have somewhat to say unto thee.” And he saith, “Master, say on.”
There was a certain creditor which had two debtors: the one owed five hundred pence, and the other fifty.
And when they had nothing to pay, he frankly forgave them both. Tell me therefore, which of them will love him most?
Simon answered and said, “I suppose that he, to whom he forgave most.” And he said unto him, “Thou hast rightly judged.”

And he turned to the woman, and said unto Simon, “Seest thou this woman? I entered into thine house, thou gavest me no water for my feet: but she hath washed my feet with tears, and wiped them with the hairs of her head.
Thou gavest me no kiss: but this woman since the time I came in hath not ceased to kiss my feet.
"Though I have not received you, she has indeed taken hold of my feet."
"Therefore I say unto you, her many sins have been forgiven; for she loved much. But he who is forgiven little, loves little."
"And to the woman, He said, 'Your sins are forgiven.'"
"And those who sat at the table with Him began to say among themselves, 'Who is this who even forgives sins?'"
"And He said to the woman, 'Your faith has saved you; go in peace.'"

sections.title: Our Lord, concerning the regions of Galilee, has been made manifest unto them.

verses.text: ከዚህም በኋላ ጌታችን ኢየሱስ በየከተማዉና በየመንደሩ ተመላለሰ፤ የእግዚአብሔርንም መንግሥት ሰበከላቸው፤ አስተማራቸውም፤ ዐሥራ ሁለቱ ደቀ መዛሙርትም ከእርሱ ጋር ነበሩ።
ከክፉዎች አጋንንትና ከደዌያቸው ያዳናቸው ሴቶችም አብረውት ነበሩ። እነርሱም፦ መግደላዊት የምትባለው ሰባት አጋንንት የወጡላት ማርያም፥
የሄሮድስ አዛዥ የነበረው የኩዛ ሚስት ዮሐና፥ ሶስናም፥ በገንዘባቸው ያገለግሉት የነበሩ ብዙዎች ሌሎችም ነበሩ።

sections.title: Concerning the parable of the sower.

verses.text: And all the people, as they came from every city unto Him, spake unto Him in this parable.
“A sower went forth to sow; and as he sowed, some fell by the wayside, and the fowls of the air came and devoured it up.
And some fell upon stony ground, where it had not much earth; and immediately it sprang up, because it had no depth of earth.
And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprang up and choked it.
But other fell into good ground, and brought forth fruit, some an hundredfold, some sixtyfold, some thirtyfold.” And He said, “He who hath ears to hear, let him hear.”
And His disciples came and said unto Him, “What might this parable be?”
And He said unto them, “Unto you it is given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of God; but to others in parables; that seeing they might not see, and hearing they might not understand.”
The parable is this: The seed is the word of God;
Those by the wayside are they that hear; then cometh the devil, and taketh away the word out of their hearts, lest they should believe and be saved.
They on the rock are they, which, when they hear, receive the word with joy; and these have no root, which for a while believe, and in time of temptation fall away.

Among the ashes, those who have heard the word that has fallen, the thoughts of the proud, and the struggles of life, and the burdens of sorrow and joy that cause them distress, and the fruits that do not bear, are they.
But in the good land, those who hear the word with a good and pure heart, and keep it, are they who will bear fruit with patience and perseverance.
"No one lights a lamp and puts it under a basket; rather, they place it on a stand, so that those who enter may see the light."
There is no hidden thing that shall not be revealed; nor is there anything concealed that shall not be made known and come to light.
Therefore, consider how you hear; to the one who has, more will be given; and from the one who has not, even what he thinks he has will be taken away."

sections.title: And concerning the brethren, it was spoken.

verses.text: And his mother and his brothers came to him; but the crowd was so great that they were not able to reach him.
"Your mother and your brothers stand outside, desiring to see you," they said.
But he answered and said to them, "My mother and my brothers are those who hear the word of God and do it."

sections.title: Concerning the calming of the sea.

verses.text: And it came to pass on one of the days, that he went out with his disciples to the sea, and he said unto them, "Come, let us go to the lake." And they went.
And as they were going, there arose a great wind upon the sea, and the water filled their boat; and they were afraid.
And they came near, saying, "Master, Master, we perish!" And they awoke him, and he rebuked the wind and the raging of the water; and they ceased, and there was a great calm.
And he said unto them, "Where is your faith?" And they, being afraid, wondered, saying one to another, "What manner of man is this, that he commandeth even the winds and water, and they obey him?"

sections.title: The man who has been afflicted by his own deeds shall be judged.

verses.text: And after this, they went to the region of Galilee, towards the land of the Gerasenes, in a boat.
And when he descended to the land, a man met him from the city, who had not worn clothes for a long time; and he did not dwell in a house, but in the tombs.
When our Lord Jesus saw him, he cried out, saying, “What have I to do with you, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? I beg you, do not torment me!” with a loud voice, lest he should be tormented.
For the evil spirit had seized him, and he had been kept under guard, bound with chains; but he broke the bonds and was driven by the demon into the wilderness.
Our Lord Jesus asked him, “What is your name?” And he said, “Legion,” for many demons had entered him.
And they begged him not to command them to go out into the abyss.
And there was a herd of many swine feeding on the mountain; and they begged him to permit them to enter the swine, and he permitted them.
Then the demons went out of the man and entered the swine; and the herd ran violently down the steep place into the lake and drowned.
When those who fed them saw what had happened, they fled and told it in the city and in the country.
Then they went out to see what had happened, and came to Jesus, and found the man from whom the demons had departed, sitting at the feet of Jesus, clothed and in his right mind; and they were afraid.
And they spoke of the man who had been with them, saying, "How is it that he has become like a judge among us?"
And the people who were around him said to them, "Let them go forth from among us; for they are filled with great fear; and our Lord Jesus returned to them."
That man who had been cast out should go with him, saying, "Our Lord Jesus."
But he said, "Return to your house and tell all the great things that God has done for you." And he went away, and throughout the whole city, our Lord Jesus was proclaimed.
And when our Lord Jesus returned, the people received him with one accord; for all were waiting for him.

sections.title: Concerning the daughter of Mikur, let her blood be avenged for that which she hath suffered.

verses.text: እነሆም ኢያኢሮስ የሚባል ሰው መጣ፤ እርሱም የምኵራብ ሹም ነበር፤ ከጌታችን ኢየሱስ እግር በታችም ሰገደ። ወደ ቤቱም ይገባ ዘንድ ለመነው።
ዕድሜዋ ዐሥራ ሁለት ዓመት የሚሆናት አንዲት ልጅ ነበረችው፤ እርስዋም ልትሞት ቀርባ ነበረች።
ከዚህም በኋላ ጌታችን ኢየሱስ ከእርሱ ጋር ሲሄድ ሰዎች ያጨናንቁት ነበር፤ ከዐሥራ ሁለት ዓመትም ጀምሮ ደም ይፈስሳት የነበረች ሴት መጣች፤ ገንዘብዋንም ሁሉ ለባለመድኀኒቶች ሰጥታ ጨርሳ ነበር፤ ነገር ግን ሊያድናት የቻለ ማንም አልነበረም።
ቀርባም በጌታችን በኢየሱስ በስተኋላው ቆመችና የልብሱን ጫፍ ዳሰሰች፤ ያንጊዜም የደምዋ መፍሰስ ቆመ።
ጌታችን ኢየሱስም፥ “ማን ዳሰሰኝ?” አለ፤ ሁሉም ካዱ፤ ጴጥሮስና ከእርሱ ጋር የነበሩትም፥ “መምህር ሆይ፥ ሰው ይጋፋህና ያጨናንቅህ የለምን? አንተ ግን ማን ዳሰሰኝ? ትላለህ” አሉት።
ጌታችን ኢየሱስም፥ “የዳሰሰኝ አለ፤ ከእኔ ኀይል እንደ ወጣ ዐውቃለሁና” አላቸው።
ሴቲቱም እንዳልተሰወረላት ባየች ጊዜ እየተንቀጠቀጠች ሄዳ ሰገደችለት፤ በሕዝቡም ሁሉ ፊት በምን ምክንያት ወደ እርሱ እንደ ቀረበችና የልብሱን ጫፍ እንደ ዳሰሰች ወዲያውም እንደ ዳነች ተናገረች።
እርሱም፥ “ልጄ ሆይ፥ እምነትሽ አዳነችሽ፤ በሰላም ሂጂ” አላት።
ይህንም ሲናገር አንድ ሰው ከምኵራቡ ሹም ቤት መጥቶ፥ “ልጅህስ ሞታለች እንግዲህ መምህሩን አታድክመው” አለው።
ጌታችን ኢየሱስም በሰማ ጊዜ የምኵራቡን ሹም፥ “አትፍራ፥ ብቻ እመን፤ ልጅህስ ትድናለች” አለው።
And when He entered the house, none was permitted to enter with Him, except for Peter, and James, and John, and the father and mother of the maiden.
And all were weeping and lamenting for her; but our Lord Jesus said, “Do not weep; she is not dead, but sleeps.”
For she is not dead, but sleeps.
But He took them all outside, and taking her by the hand, He called, saying, “Little girl, arise.”
And her spirit returned, and she arose immediately; and He commanded that she be given something to eat.
And her parents were astonished; but He charged them to tell no one what had happened.

sections.title: Concerning the Apostles, the Messenger.

verses.text: He called unto the twelve apostles, and gave them power and authority over all devils, and to cure diseases.
That they might preach the kingdom of God, and to heal the sick and all manner of infirmities.
And he said unto them, “Whether it be a staff, or a purse, or bread, or gold, or two coats, take nothing for the journey.”
In whatsoever house ye enter, there abide, and thence depart not.
But if they receive you not, go your ways out of that city, and shake off the very dust from your feet for a testimony against them.”
And they departed, and went through the towns, preaching the gospel, and healing everywhere.

sections.title: Concerning the thoughts of Herod.

verses.text: የአራተኛው ክፍል ገዥ ሄሮድስም የተደረገውን ሁሉ ሰምቶ የሚናገረውን ያጣ ነበር፤ መጥምቁ ዮሐንስ ከሙታን ተለይቶ ተነሣ የሚሉ ነበሩና።
ኤልያስ ተገለጠ የሚሉም ነበሩ፤ ከቀደሙት ነቢያት አንዱ ተነሥቶአል የሚሉም ነበሩና።
ሄሮድስም፥ “እኔ የዮሐንስን ራስ አስቈረጥሁ፤ እንግዲህ ስለ እርሱ ሲወራ የምሰማው ይህ ማነው?” አለ፤ ሊያየውም ይሻ ነበር።
ሐዋርያትም በተመለሱ ጊዜ ያደረጉትን ሁሉ ነገሩት፤ እርሱም ለብቻቸው ይዞአቸው ቤተ ሳይዳ ከምትባል ከተማ አጠገብ ወደ አለ ምድረ በዳ ወጡ።
ሕዝቡም ዐውቀው ተከተሉት፤ እርሱም ተቀበላቸው፤ ስለ እግዚአብሔር መንግሥትም አስተማራቸው፤ ሊፈወሱ የሚሹትንም አዳናቸው።

sections.title: Concerning the blessing of the humble.

verses.text: And it came to pass, in the time of the evening, that the twelve disciples came unto Him, saying, “Behold, this is a desert place, and the time is now past; send the multitude away, that they may go into the villages and buy themselves victuals.”
But He said unto them, “Give ye them to eat.” And they said, “We have here but five loaves and two fishes.”
And the people were about five thousand men. And He said to His disciples, “Make them sit down by fifties in a company.”
And they did so, and made them all sit down.
And He took the five loaves and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, He blessed them, and brake, and gave to the disciples to set before the multitude.
And they did eat, and were all filled: and there was taken up of fragments that remained to them twelve baskets.

sections.title: Who is man that You are mindful of him? Thus spoke the disciple, inquiring concerning this matter.

verses.text: And after this, as He prayed alone, His disciples were with Him, and He asked them, saying, "Whom do the people say that I am?"
They answered and said, "John the Baptist; but some say, Elijah; and others say, that one of the old prophets is risen again."
He said unto them, "But whom say ye that I am?" Peter answering said, "Thou art the Christ of God."
And He strictly charged them, and commanded them to tell no man that thing.

sections.title: Concerning the affliction and that which hath been spoken.

verses.text: "For the son of man, much affliction shall befall him, for the scribes and the chief priests shall conspire against him, and they shall deliver him up to be killed, and on the third day he shall rise again."
"Thus he spoke to them all, saying, 'If anyone desires to follow me, let him deny himself; let him take up his cross daily and follow me.'"
"All who wish to save their life will lose it; but whoever loses their life for my sake will save it."
"For what does it profit a man if he gains the whole world, and loses his own soul?"
"For whoever is ashamed of me and my words, of him the Son of Man will be ashamed when he comes in his own glory, and in his Father’s, and of the holy angels."
"Truly I say to you, there are some standing here who shall not taste death till they see the kingdom of God."

sections.title: Concerning the glory of His revelation on Mount Tabor.

verses.text: And after this, on the eighth day, our Lord Jesus took Peter, James, and John with Him and went up to the mountain to pray.
And while He prayed, the appearance of His face was altered, and His clothing became white and glistening.
Behold, two men talked with Him, who were Moses and Elijah.
They appeared in glory and spoke of His departure, which He was about to accomplish at Jerusalem.
But Peter and those with him were heavy with sleep; and when they were fully awake, they saw His glory and the two men who stood with Him.

Then it happened, as they were parting from Him, that Peter said to Jesus, “Master, it is good for us to be here; and let us make three tabernacles: one for You, one for Moses, and one for Elijah,” not knowing what he said.
While he was saying this, a cloud came and overshadowed them; and they were fearful as they entered the cloud.
And a voice came out of the cloud, saying, “This is My beloved Son. Hear Him!”
When the voice had ceased, Jesus was found alone. But they kept quiet, and told no one in those days any of the things they had seen.

sections.title: "Let them take away the one who was in the midst of the congregation for the sake of the wicked."

verses.text: And on the second day, they descended from the mountain; and a great multitude received them.
And one man cried out in the midst of the people, saying, "Teacher, behold, he is one with me; therefore I beseech you to look upon my son."
Behold, my son is possessed; and he has cried out in anguish; he has been seized with torment; he has been thrown into convulsions; he is being cast down into the fire.
And to cast them out, your disciples were unable; yet they were unable to expel him."
Our Lord Jesus answered, saying, "O faithless generation, how long shall I be with you? How long shall I bear with you? Bring your son here."

And while he was coming, the demon threw him down and convulsed him; but our Lord Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, healed the boy, and gave him back to his father. And all were amazed at the greatness of God.

sections.title: Concerning the affliction.

verses.text: And they said to His disciples, "Behold, our Lord Jesus, when He performed all these miracles, spoke to them thus."
"But you, ponder this matter in your hearts; for the Son of Man is to be delivered into the hands of men."
Yet they did not understand this saying; for it was hidden from them, so that they might not perceive it; and they were afraid to ask Him about this matter.

sections.title: Concerning humility.

verses.text: They thought among themselves, "Who then is greater than he?"
Our Lord Jesus, knowing what they were thinking in their hearts, took a child and set him in the midst of them.
And He said to them, "Whoever receives this child in My name receives Me, and whoever receives Me receives Him who sent Me; for he who is least among you all is the greatest."
John answered and said, "Teacher, we saw someone casting out demons in Your name, and we forbade him because he does not follow with us."
But Jesus said to them, "Do not forbid him; for he who is not against us is on our side."
And when the days of His ascension were drawing near, He steadfastly set His face to go to Jerusalem.
And He sent messengers before His face; and as they went, they entered a village of the Samaritans to prepare for Him.
But they did not receive Him, because His face was set for the journey to Jerusalem.
And the disciples James and John, seeing this, said, "Lord, do You want us to command fire to come down from heaven and consume them, just as Elijah did?"
But He turned and rebuked them, saying, "You do not know what manner of spirit you are of."
The Son of man came not to destroy the souls of men, but to save them. And they went to another place.

sections.title: For those who have asked to follow Him.

verses.text: And it came to pass, as they journeyed in the way, that one said unto Him, “Master, I will follow Thee whithersoever Thou goest.”
But our Lord Jesus said, “Foxes have holes, and birds of the air have nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay His head.”
And another said, “Lord, suffer me first to go and bury my father.”
Our Lord Jesus replied, “Let the dead bury their dead; but go thou and preach the kingdom of God.”
And another also said, “Lord, I will follow Thee; but let me first go bid them farewell which are at home.”
And our Lord Jesus said, “No man, having put his hand to the plough, and looking back, is fit for the kingdom of God.”

sections.title: And they chose seven men.

verses.text: ከዚህም በኋላ ጌታችን ሌሎች ሰባ ሰዎችን መረጠ፤ ሁለት ሁለት አድርጎም ሊሄድበት ወደ አለው ከተማና መንደር በፊቱ ላካቸው።
ጌታችን ኢየሱስም አላቸው፥ “መከሩ ብዙ ነው፤ ሠራተኛው ግን ጥቂት ነው፤ እንግዲህ ለመከሩ ሠራተኛ ጨምሮ ይልክ ዘንድ ባለ መከሩን ለምኑት።
ሂዱ፤ እነሆ፥ እኔ እንደ በጎች በተኵላዎች መካከል እልካችኋለሁ።
ከረጢትም፥ ስልቻም፥ ጫማም፥ ምንም ምን አትያዙ፤ በመንገድም ማንንም ሰላም አትበሉ።
ወደ ገባችሁበት ቤትም አስቀድማችሁ ‘ለዚህ ቤት ሰዎች ሰላም ይሁን’ በሉ።
በዚያም የሰላም ልጅ ቢኖር ሰላማችሁ ያድርበታል፤ ያለዚያ ግን ሰላማችሁ ይመለስላችኋል።
በዚያም ቤት ተቀመጡ፤ ከእነርሱ የተገኘውንም ብሉ፥ ጠጡም፤ ለሠራተኛ ዋጋው ይገባዋልና፤ ከቤትም ወደ ቤት አትሂዱ።
ወደ ማናቸውም ከተማ ብትገቡ፥ የዚያ ከተማ ሰዎችም ቢቀበሉአችሁ ያቀረቡላችሁን ብሉ።
በውስጥዋ የሚገኙትን ድውያንንም ፈውሱ፤ ‘የእግዚአብሔርም መንግሥት ወደ እናንተ ቀርባለች’ በሉአቸው።
ነገር ግን ወደ ማናቸውም ከተማ ብትገቡ፥ የዚያች ከተማ ሰዎችም ባይቀበሉአችሁ ወደ አደባባይዋ ወጥታችሁ የእግራችሁን ትቢያ አራግፉ። እንዲህም በሉ፦
Even though we shall be grieved for the city that has been destroyed, know this: the kingdom of God has drawn near unto you.
I tell you, it shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom in the day of judgment than for that city.
"Woe unto you, Chorazin! Woe unto you, Bethsaida! For if the mighty works done in you had been done in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes."
Nevertheless, I say unto you, it shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the day of judgment than for you.
And thou, Capernaum, which art exalted unto heaven, shalt be brought down to hell.
"He who hears you hears me; and he who rejects you rejects me; and he who rejects me rejects him who sent me."

sections.title: Concerning the return of the seven messengers.

verses.text: And they returned with joy, saying, “Master, even the demons are subject to us in Your name.”
And He said to them, “I saw Satan fall from heaven like lightning.
Behold, I have given you authority to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy, and nothing shall hurt you.
Nevertheless, do not rejoice in this, that the spirits are subject to you, but rather rejoice because your names are written in heaven.”

In that hour, our Lord Jesus rejoiced in the Holy Spirit and said, “I thank You, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that You have hidden these things from the wise and prudent and revealed them to babes. Even so, Father, for so it seemed good in Your sight.
All things have been delivered to Me by My Father, and no one knows who the Son is except the Father, and who the Father is except the Son, and the one to whom the Son wills to reveal Him.”
Then He turned to His disciples and said privately, “Blessed are the eyes which see the things you see;
for I tell you that many prophets and kings have desired to see what you see, and have not seen it, and to hear what you hear, and have not heard it.”

sections.title: The Lord tested the law, O wise one.

verses.text: ከዚህ በኋላ አንድ ሕግ ዐዋቂ ሊፈትነው ተነሣና፥ “መምህር ሆይ፥ የዘለዓለም ሕይወትን እወርስ ዘንድ ምን ላድርግ?” አለው።
እርሱም፥ “በኦሪት ምን ተጽፎአል? እንዴትስ ታነብባለህ?” አለው።
እርሱም መልሶ፥ “እግዚአብሔር አምላክህን በፍጹም ልብህ፥ በፍጹም ሰውነትህ፥ በፍጹም ኀይልህ፥ በፍጹም ዐሳብህ ውደደው፤ ባልንጀራህንም እንደ ራስህ ውደድ ይላል” አለው።
ጌታችን ኢየሱስም፥ “መልካም መልሰሃል፤ እንዲሁ አድርግ፤ ትድናለህም” አለው።
ራሱን ሊያከብር ባልንጀራውንም ሊንቅ ወድዶ፥ “ባልንጀራዬ ማነው?” አለው።

sections.title: Concerning the one who is humble.

verses.text: Our Lord Jesus answered and said, “A certain man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho; and he fell among thieves, who stripped him of his clothing, wounded him, and departed, leaving him half dead.
Now by chance a certain priest came down that road; and when he saw him, he passed by on the other side.
Likewise a Levite, when he arrived at the place, came and looked, and passed by on the other side.
But a certain Samaritan, as he journeyed, came where he was; and when he saw him, he had compassion.
So he went to him and bandaged his wounds, pouring on oil and wine; and he set him on his own animal, brought him to an inn, and took care of him.
On the next day, when he departed, he took out two denarii, gave them to the innkeeper, and said, ‘Take care of him; and whatever more you spend, when I come again, I will repay you.’
Which of these three do you think was neighbor to him who fell among the thieves?”
And he said, “He who showed mercy on him.” Then Jesus said to him, “Go and do likewise.”

sections.title: Concerning Mary and Martha

verses.text: And after this, they went into a certain village; and a woman named Martha received Him into her house.
And there was a sister called Mary, who also sat at the feet of our Lord Jesus and heard His teaching.
But Martha was cumbered about much serving; and she came to Him and said, “Lord, dost Thou not care that my sister hath left me to serve alone? Bid her therefore that she help me.”
And our Lord Jesus answered and said unto her, “Martha, Martha, thou art careful and troubled about many things;
but one thing is needful; and Mary hath chosen that good part, which shall not be taken away from her.”

sections.title: Concerning Prayer

verses.text: And after this, he prayed in a certain place; and when he ceased, one of his disciples said unto him, “Lord, teach us to pray, as John also taught his disciples.”
And he said unto them, “When ye pray, say: Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name; Thy kingdom come; Thy will be done, as in heaven, so in earth.”
Give us day by day our daily bread.
And forgive us our sins; for we also forgive every one that is indebted to us. And lead us not into temptation; but deliver us from evil.”
And he said unto them, “Which of you shall have a friend, and shall go unto him at midnight, and say unto him, ‘Friend, lend me three loaves;
For a friend of mine in his journey is come to me, and I have nothing to set before him’?
And he from within shall answer and say, ‘Trouble me not; the door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed; I cannot rise and give thee’?
I say unto you, Though he will not rise and give him, because he is his friend, yet because of his importunity he will rise and give him as many as he needeth.
And I say unto you, Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you.
For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.
ከእናንተ መካከል ልጁ ዳቦ የሚለምነው አባት ቢኖር ድንጋይ ይሰጠዋልን? ዓሣ ቢለምነውስ በዓሣ ፋንታ እባብን ይሰጠዋልን?
ወይስ ዕንቍላል ቢለምነው በዕንቍላል ፋንታ ጊንጥ ይሰጠዋልን?
እናንተ ክፉዎች ስትሆኑ ለልጆቻችሁ መልካም ስጦታን መስጠትን የምታውቁ ከሆነ፥ የሰማይ አባታችሁማ ለሚለምኑት መልካሙን ሀብተ መንፈስ ቅዱስ እንዴት አብዝቶ ይሰጣቸው ይሆን?”

sections.title: For the one who has taken the poor man.

verses.text: And there was a certain demon-possessed man who was brought forth; and when he was brought forth, the demon-possessed man spoke, and the people were amazed.
But among them were those who said, “By the ruler of the demons, He casts out demons.” And He answered them, “How can Satan cast out Satan?”
Others sought to test Him, asking for a sign from heaven.
But He knew their thoughts and said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation, and every house divided against itself will not stand.
If Satan is divided against himself, how will his kingdom stand? For you say that I cast out demons by Beelzebub.
If I cast out demons by Beelzebub, by whom do your sons cast them out? Therefore they will be your judges.
But if I cast out demons with the finger of God, surely the kingdom of God has come upon you.
When a strong man, fully armed, guards his own palace, his goods are in peace.
But when a stronger than he comes upon him and overcomes him, he takes from him all his armor in which he trusted, and divides his spoils.
He who is not with me is against me, and he who does not gather with me scatters.
"When the wicked go out from a man, he wanders in a dry wilderness; he shall find a place to dwell, and he shall say, 'I will return to my house from whence I came.'"
"At the appointed time, he shall be turned back and shall find it."
"After this, he shall go and bring with him seven other spirits more wicked than himself; and they shall enter in and dwell there; and the last state of that man shall be worse than the first."

sections.title: Concerning the woman who was spoken of among the Ahzab.

verses.text: And after this, as he spoke, a woman from among the people raised her voice and said, "Blessed is the womb that bore you; and blessed are the breasts which nursed you."
But he said, "Blessed rather are those who hear the word of God and keep it."

sections.title: Concerning those who seek a sign.

verses.text: And many people gathered together, and they began to say, “This generation is an evil generation; it seeks a sign, but no sign shall be given to it except the sign of the prophet Jonah.
For as Jonah was a sign to the people of Nineveh, so will the Son of Man be a sign to this generation.
The queen of the South will rise up in judgment with this generation and condemn it; for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon, and indeed, a greater than Solomon is here.
The men of Nineveh will rise up in judgment with this generation and condemn it; for they repented at the preaching of Jonah, and indeed, a greater than Jonah is here.
“No one, when he has lit a lamp, puts it in a secret place or under a basket, but on a lampstand, that those who enter may see the light.
The lamp of the body is the eye. Therefore, when your eye is good, your whole body also is full of light; but when your eye is bad, your body is full of darkness.
Therefore take heed that the light which is in you is not darkness.
If then your whole body is full of light, having no part dark, the whole body will be full of light, as when the bright shining of a lamp gives you light.”

sections.title: Our Lord Jesus, when He was called to the meal by the Pharisee.

verses.text: And while He spoke these things, a certain Pharisee asked Him to dine with him; and He went in and sat down to meat.
The Pharisee, seeing it, marveled that He had not first washed before dinner.
Our Lord Jesus said unto them, “Woe unto you, Pharisees! For ye cleanse the outside of the cup and the platter; but your inward part is full of ravening and wickedness.
Ye fools! Did not He that made that which is without make that which is within also?
But rather give alms of such things as ye have; and, behold, all things are clean unto you.

But woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For ye tithe mint and anise and cummin, and have omitted the weightier matters of the law, judgment, mercy, and faith: these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the other undone.
Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For ye love the uppermost rooms at feasts, and the chief seats in the synagogues,
And greetings in the markets, and to be called of men, Rabbi, Rabbi.
Then one of the lawyers answered and said unto Him, “Master, thus saying, Thou reproachest us also.”
And He said, “Woe unto you also, ye lawyers! For ye lade men with burdens grievous to be borne, and ye yourselves touch not the burdens with one of your fingers.”
Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees! For ye build the tombs of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.
The works of your fathers have brought you joy; yet ye are witnesses against yourselves that ye are the children of them which killed the prophets.
Wherefore, behold, the wisdom of God saith, I will send prophets and apostles unto them, and some of them they shall slay and persecute;
That the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from the foundation of the world, may be required of this generation;
From the blood of Abel unto the blood of Zacharias, which perished between the altar and the temple: verily I say unto you, It shall be required of this generation.
Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees! For ye shut up the kingdom of heaven against men: for ye neither go in yourselves, neither suffer ye them that are entering to go in.
And when he spake, the scribes and Pharisees began to urge him vehemently, and to provoke him to speak of many things;
Laying wait for him, and seeking to catch something out of his mouth, that they might accuse him.

sections.title: Concerning the Pharisees, I say unto you.

verses.text: በዚያን ጊዜም እጅግ ብዙ ሰዎች እርስ በርሳቸው እስኪረጋገጡ ድረስ ወደ እርሱ ተሰበሰቡ፤ ደቀ መዛሙርቱንም እንዲህ ይላቸው ጀመረ፥ “አስቀድማችሁ ከፈሪሳውያን እርሾ ተጠበቁ፤ ይኸውም ግብዝነት ነው።
የማይገለጥ የተሰወረ፥ የማይታይም የተሸሸገ የለምና።
በጨለማ የምትናገሩት በብርሃን ይሰማል፤ በእልፍኝም ውስጥ በጆሮ የምትንሾካሾኩት በሰገነት ይሰበካል።
ለእናንተ ለወዳጆች እላችኋለሁ፦ ሥጋችሁን የሚገድሉትን አትፍሩአቸው፤ ከዚህም የበለጠ ማድረግ የሚችሉት የላቸውም።
ነገር ግን፤ የምትፈሩትን አሳያችኋለሁ፤ እናንተስ ከገደለ በኋላ ወደ ገሃነም ሊጥል ሥልጣን ያለውን ፍሩት፤ አዎ፥ እላችኋለሁ፤ እርሱን ፍሩ።
አምስት ወፎች በሁለት ሻሚ መሐለቅ ይሸጡ የለምን? ከእነርሱ አንዲቱ ስንኳን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት አትረሳም።
የእናንተስ የራስ ጠጕራችሁ ሁሉ የተቈጠረ ነው፤ እንግዲህ አትፍሩ፤ ከብዙ ወፎች እናንተ ትበልጣላችሁና።
“እላችኋለሁ፦ በሰው ፊት የሚያምንብኝን ሁሉ እኔም በእግዚአብሔር መላእክት ፊት አምነዋለሁ።
በሰው ፊት የሚክደኝን ግን እኔም በእግዚአብሔር መላእክት ፊት እክደዋለሁ።
በሰው ልጅ ላይ የስድብ ቃል የሚናገር ሁሉ ይሰረይለታል፤ በመንፈስ ቅዱስ ላይ የስድብ ቃል የሚናገር ግን በዚህ ዓለምም ሆነ በሚመጣው ዓለም አይሰረይለትም።
And to the chief priests and to the scribes and to the rulers, and to the elders, when they shall lead you, do not be anxious concerning what you shall say or how you shall speak.
For at that time, the Holy Spirit shall speak through you.

sections.title: Inheritance shall be granted unto the one whom it is due.

verses.text: One of the people said, "O teacher, tell my brother to divide the inheritance with me."
Our Lord Jesus said, "You, man, who made me a judge or an arbiter over you?"
"Take heed; beware of all covetousness, for a man's life does not consist in the abundance of his possessions," He said to them.

sections.title: The field is blessed for the sake of the diligent.

verses.text: The parables are like this; thus it is said: "There was a man of wealth, a possessor of a field, and a prosperous land."
"I have no place to dwell, and thus I ponder in my heart what I shall do."
And he said: "Thus will I do; I will pull down my barns and build greater; and there I will store all my grain and my goods."
"And to my soul I will say: 'Soul, you have ample goods laid up for many years; relax, eat, drink, be merry.'"
But God said to him: "Fool! This night your soul is required of you; and the things you have prepared, whose will they be?"
"So is the one who lays up treasure for himself and is not rich toward God."

sections.title: For it is not fitting to engage in vain disputes.

verses.text: ለደቀ መዛሙርቱም እንዲህ አላቸው፥ “ስለዚህ እላችህዋለሁ፤ ለነፍሳችሁ ስለምትበሉትና ስለምትጠጡት፥ ለሰውነታችሁም ስለምትለብሱት አትጨነቁ።
ነፍስ ከምግብ ትበልጣለችና፤ ሰውነትም ከልብስ ይበልጣልና።
የማይዘሩትንና የማያጭዱትን፥ ጎተራና ጕድጓድ የሌላቸውን የቍራዎችን ጫጭቶች ተመልከቱ፤ እግዚአብሔር ግን ይመግባቸዋል፤ እንግዲህ እናንተ ከወፎች እንዴት እጅግ አትበልጡም?
ከእናንተስ ዐስቦ በቁመቱ ላይ አንድ ክንድ መጨመር የሚቻለው ማነው?
ይህን ቀላሉን የማትችሉ ከሆነ በሌላው ለምን ትጨነቃላችሁ?
እነሆ፥ አበባዎችን እንደሚያድጉ ተመልከቱ፤ አይፈትሉም፤ አይደክሙም፤ ነገር ግን እላችኋለሁ፤ ሰሎሞን እንኳ በክብሩ ዘመን ሁሉ ከእነርሱ እንደ አንዱ አልለበሰም።
እነሆ፥ ዛሬ ያለውን፥ ነገም ወደ እሳት የሚጣለውን የአበባ አገዳ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ የሚያደርገው ከሆነ፥ እናንተ እምነት የጐደላችሁ፥ ለእናንተማ እንዴት አብልጦ አያደርግላችሁ?
እናንተም የምትበሉትንና የምትጠጡትን አትፈልጉ፤ ወዲያና ወዲህም አትበሉ፤ አትጨነቁለትም።
ይህን ሁሉ በውጭ ያሉ የዓለም አሕዛብ ይሹታልና፤ ለእናንተስ አባታችሁ ይህን ሁሉ እንደምትሹት ያውቃል።
ነገር ግን የእግዚአብሔርን መንግሥትና ጽድቅ ሹ፤ ይህም ሁሉ ይጨመርላችኋል።
"Fear not, little flock; for your Father has been pleased to give you the kingdom."
"Sell your possessions and give alms; provide yourselves with purses that do not grow old, with a treasure in the heavens that does not fail, where no thief approaches and no moth destroys."
"For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also."

sections.title: Concerning the act of sacrifice.

verses.text: "And your lamp shall be kept burning bright."
"And you, when the master of the house comes, shall be ready, like those who wait for their lord, that when he comes and knocks, they may open to him immediately."
"Blessed are those servants whom the master, when he comes, will find watching. Truly, I say to you, that he will gird himself and have them sit down to eat, and will come and serve them."
"And if he should come in the second watch, or in the third watch, and find them so, blessed are those servants."
"But know this, that if the master of the house had known what hour the thief would come, he would have watched and not allowed his house to be broken into."
"Therefore you also be ready, for the Son of Man is coming at an hour you do not expect."
"Then Peter said to Him, 'Lord, do You speak this parable only to us, or to all people?'"
"And the Lord said, 'Who then is that faithful and wise steward, whom his master will make ruler over his household, to give them their portion of food in due season?'"
"Blessed is that servant whom his master will find so doing when he comes."
"Truly, I say to you, that he will make him ruler over all that he has."
ነገር ግን ያ ክፉ አገልጋይ በልቡ፦ ጌታዬ ቶሎ አይመጣም ቢል፥ በጌታው ቤት ያሉትንም ወንዶችንና ሴቶችን አገልጋዮች ሊደበድብና ሊያጕላላ ቢጀምር፥ ከሰካራሞችም ጋር ቢበላና ቢጠጣ፥ ቢሰክርም፥
የዚያ አገልጋይ ጌታ ባልጠረጠረው ዕለት፥ ባላወቀውም ሰዓት መጥቶ ከሁለት ይሰነጥቀዋል፤ ዕድሉንም ከማይታመኑ ጋር ያደርገዋል።
የጌታውን ፈቃድ ዐውቆ እንደ ፈቃዱ የማይሠራና የማያዘጋጅ የዚያ አገልጋይ ቅጣቱ ብዙ ነው።
ያላወቀ ግን ባይሠራም ቅጣቱ ጥቂት ነው፤ ብዙ ከሰጡት ብዙ ይፈልጉበታልና። ጥቂት ከሰጡትም ጥቂት ይፈልጉበታልና።

sections.title: Concerning the sword and concerning distinction.

verses.text: "I have come to bring fire upon the earth; and what will I wish, if it be already kindled?"
"But I have a baptism to be baptized with; and how am I straitened until it be accomplished!"
"And he said unto the people, 'Do you think that I am come to give peace on earth? I tell you, Nay; but rather division.'"
"From henceforth there shall be five in one house divided, three against two, and two against three."

"The father shall be divided against the son, and the son against the father; the mother against the daughter, and the daughter against the mother; the mother-in-law against her daughter-in-law, and the daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law."
"And after this, he said unto the people, 'When you see a cloud rise out of the west, straightway you say, There cometh a shower; and so it is.'”
"And when you see the south wind blow, you say, There will be heat; and it cometh to pass."
"Ye hypocrites! ye can discern the face of the sky and of the earth; but how is it that ye do not discern this time?"
"And why even of yourselves judge ye not what is right?"

"When thou goest with thine adversary to the magistrate, as thou art in the way, give diligence that thou mayest be delivered from him; lest he hale thee to the judge, and the judge deliver thee to the officer, and the officer cast thee into prison. I tell thee, thou shalt not depart thence, till thou hast paid the very last mite."
"Even if it be but a half-santim of what is yours at the end, I say unto you, do not depart until you have completed it."

sections.title: Concerning the soul.

verses.text: In those days, people came to Him and spoke to Pilate about the Galileans, whose blood Pilate had mingled with their sacrifices.
Our Lord Jesus answered them, saying, “Do you think that these Galileans were worse sinners than all the other Galileans, because they suffered such things?
I tell you, no; but unless you repent, you will all likewise perish.
Or do you suppose that those eighteen on whom the tower in Siloam fell and killed them were worse offenders than all the others who lived in Jerusalem?
I tell you, no; but unless you repent, you will all likewise perish.”

sections.title: Fruit for another.

verses.text: And thus he spoke unto them, saying, "A certain man had a vineyard, and he planted it; and he went to gather its fruits, but he found it not."
And the keeper of the vineyard said, "Behold, this fig tree hath been three years in this place, and I found no fruit on it; therefore, let it be cut down, lest it consume the ground."
And he answered and said unto him, "Lord, let it alone this year also, till I shall dig about it and dung it; and if it bear fruit, well; but if not, then after that thou shalt cut it down."
"Perhaps it may yet bear fruit; but if not, we shall remove it."

sections.title: On the Sabbath day concerning the woman who was healed.

verses.text: And on the Sabbath, He taught them in one synagogue.
There was a woman who had been afflicted with a spirit of infirmity for eighteen years; she was bent over and could in no way raise herself up.
Our Lord Jesus saw her, and He called to her, saying, “Woman, you are loosed from your infirmity.”
And He laid His hands on her; and immediately she was made straight, and she glorified God.

But the ruler of the synagogue answered with indignation, because Jesus had healed on the Sabbath; and he said to the crowd, “There are six days on which men ought to work; therefore come and be healed on them, and not on the Sabbath day.”
The Lord answered him and said, “Hypocrite! Does not each one of you on the Sabbath loose his ox or donkey from the stall and lead it away to water it?
So ought not this woman, being a daughter of Abraham, whom Satan has bound—think of it—for eighteen years, be loosed from this bond on the Sabbath?”
And when He said these things, all His adversaries were put to shame; and all the multitude rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by Him.

sections.title: Concerning the parable of the fig tree.

verses.text: On that day, our Lord Jesus said unto them, "What is the kingdom of heaven like? And to what shall I compare it?

A man took and sowed a mustard seed in his field; it is indeed the least of all seeds; but when it is grown, it is the greatest among herbs, and becomes a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge in the branches thereof."

sections.title: Concerning the harvest.

verses.text: ዳግመኛም እንዲህ አለ፥ “የእግዚአብሔርን መንግሥት በምን እመስላታለሁ?
ሴት ወስዳ ሦስት መስፈሪያ ዱቄት የለወሰችበትን፥ ሁሉንም እንዲቦካ ያደረገውን እርሾ ትመስላለች”።

sections.title: Concerning those who are in need.

verses.text: And he was teaching in every city and in every village, returning to Jerusalem.
And one man said, "Lord, are there few that be saved?" But he said unto them,
"Strive to enter in at the strait gate; for many, I say unto you, will seek to enter in, and shall not be able."

When once the master of the house is risen up and hath shut to the door, and ye begin to stand without, and to knock at the door, saying, 'Lord, Lord, open unto us,' he shall answer and say unto you, 'I know you not whence ye are.'
Then shall ye begin to say, 'We have eaten and drunk in thy presence, and thou hast taught in our streets.'
But he shall say, 'I tell you, I know you not whence ye are; depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity.'
Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and all the prophets, shall be in the kingdom of God, and you yourselves thrust out.
And they shall come from the east and from the west, and from the north and from the south, and shall sit down in the kingdom of God.
And, behold, there are last which shall be first, and there are first which shall be last."

sections.title: Concerning Herod.

verses.text: On that day, there came to Him some of the Pharisees, saying, "Get away from here and go; for Herod seeks to kill You."
And He said to them, "Go tell that fox, 'Behold, I cast out demons and perform cures today and tomorrow, and the third day I shall be perfected.'”
"Nevertheless, I must journey today, tomorrow, and the day following; for it cannot be that a prophet should perish outside of Jerusalem."

sections.title: Concerning the destruction of Jerusalem.

verses.text: "O Jerusalem, thou that killest the prophets, and stonest them which are sent unto thee; how often would I have gathered thy children together, even as a hen gathereth her chickens under her wings, and ye would not!
Behold, your house is left unto you desolate; for I say unto you, Ye shall not see me henceforth, till ye shall say, Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord."

sections.title: Behold, as the man who has been cast out, so shall he be as one who is forsaken.

verses.text: And after this, He went into the house of one of the rulers of the Pharisees on the Sabbath day to eat bread; and they watched Him closely.
And behold, there was a certain man before Him who had dropsy.
And our Lord Jesus answered and spoke to the lawyers and Pharisees, saying, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath? Or not?”
But they kept silent; and He took hold of him and healed him, and let him go.
“Which of you, having a donkey or an ox that has fallen into a pit, will not immediately pull him out on the Sabbath day?” He asked them.
And they could not answer Him regarding these things.

sections.title: For those who delight in sitting in their own counsel.

verses.text: በምሳ ላይ ለነበሩትም ወደ ላይኛው ወንበር ሲሽቀዳደሙ ባያቸው ጊዜ ምሳሌ መስሎ አስተማራቸው።
እንዲህም አለ፥ “ለምሳ የጠራህ ሰው ቢኖርና ብትሄድ በላይኛው መቀመጫ አትቀመጥ፤ ምናልባት ከአንተ የሚበልጥ ይመጣ ይሆናል።
በኋላ ያ አንተንም እርሱንም የጠራ መጥቶ፦ ይህን ቦታ ለእርሱ ተውለት ይልሃልና፤ ያንጊዜም አፍረህ ትመለሳለህ፤ ወደ ዝቅተኛ ቦታም ትወርዳለህ።
የጠራህ ሰው ቢኖርና ብትሄድ ግን የጠራህ በመጣ ጊዜ ወዳጄ ወደ ላይኛው መቀመጫ ውጣ ይልህ ዘንድ በታችኛው መቀመጫ ተቀመጥ፤ ያንጊዜም ከአንተ ጋር ለማዕድ በተቀመጡት ሰዎች ፊት ክብር ይሆንልሃል።
ራሱን ከፍ የሚያደርግ ሁሉ ይዋረዳልና፤ ራሱንም ያሚያዋርድ ከፍ ይላልና።”
የጠራውንም እንዲህ አለው፥ “በበዓል ምሳ ወይም ራት በምታደርግበት ጊዜ ወዳጆችህንና ወንድሞችህን፥ ዘመዶችህንና ጎረቤቶችህን፥ ባለጸጎች ባልንጀሮችህንም አትጥራ፤ እነርሱም ይጠሩሃልና፤ ብድርም ይሆንብሃልና።
ነገር ግን በበዓል ምሳ በምታደርግበት ጊዜ ድሆችንና ጦም አዳሪዎችን፥ ዕውሮችን፥ እጅና እግርም የሌላቸውን ጥራ።
አንተም ብፁዕ ትሆናለህ፤ የሚከፍሉህ የላቸውምና፤ ነገር ግን ጻድቃን በሚነሡበት ጊዜ ዋጋህን ታገኛለህ።”
ለምሳ ከተቀመጡትም አንዱ ይህን ሰምቶ፥ “በእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት እህል የሚበላ ብፁዕ ነው” አለው።

sections.title: Concerning the call to the feast.

verses.text: Our Lord Jesus said unto them, “A certain man made a great feast and invited many.
And when the day of the feast had come, he sent his servant to call those who were invited, saying, ‘Come, for all things are now ready.’
But they all with one accord began to make excuses. The first said unto him, ‘I have bought a piece of ground, and I must needs go and see it; I pray thee, have me excused.’
And another said, ‘I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I go to prove them; I pray thee, have me excused.’
And another said, ‘I have married a wife, and therefore I cannot come.’
